title: docksec
subtitle: Go security scanner implementing CIS Docker Benchmark v1.6.0 with parallel container analysis and SARIF output for CI integration
description: A CLI tool that scans Docker environments for security misconfigurations against the CIS Docker Benchmark. Analyzes running containers, images, Dockerfiles, and compose files with 100+ controls, 40 Linux capability mappings, 200+ sensitive path definitions, and secret detection patterns. Outputs to terminal, JSON, SARIF for GitHub Security integration, or JUnit for CI pipelines.
